title: Coalesced Multi-Output Tsetlin Machines with Clause Sharing
new_feature: Clause sharing: a single pool of clauses shared by all outputs, each clause connected to every output via a signed integer weight learned with Stochastic Searching on the Line, jointly with TA-learned clause composition (Coalesced TM, CoTM).

extraction_notes: Tables 2-4 (clause sweeps) included in full for accuracy; timing only for 50 and 8K clauses; model size only for 50 clauses (22 kB; scales linearly to 3516 kB at 8K). Voting margins recorded exactly as printed, though they are inconsistent across tables (e.g. 25K vs 2.5K at 2K clauses). Discrepancies in paper: abstract attributes 71.99->89.66% (50 clauses) to Fashion-MNIST, but those numbers are in the Kuzushiji-MNIST table (Table 4); text says 98.26% for 50 clauses on MNIST while Table 2 gives 98.33. Table 5 baselines are copied from the CTM paper. Table 6 values are accuracy reductions (percentage points) vs. no removal; absolute IMDb accuracy not given. Table 7 F1 in 0-1. PDF pages could not be rendered (no poppler); text tables were clean.
